title: Get in touch
intro: Questions about the guide, the calculator or your account, a figure that looks wrong, or an idea for the site: we read every message.

form.title: Write to us
form.note: Your message goes straight to our inbox, and we use your email address only to reply. See our Privacy Policy.
form.sent: Thank you. Your message has been sent, and we aim to reply within 14 days.
form.tooMany: You have sent several messages in the last hour. Please try again later, or email us at eirehomeflow@gmail.com.
form.failed: Your message could not be sent. Please try again, or email us at eirehomeflow@gmail.com.

topics.correction: A figure or fact to correct

email.title: Email us directly
email.reply: We aim to reply within 14 days. Requests about your personal data are answered within one month.

before.title: Before you write
items: We cannot give personal financial, mortgage, legal or tax advice. For decisions, talk to a qualified professional.
To delete your account, use My profile, or email us from the address on the account.
Spotted a mistake? Tell us the step or article, and the source if you have one.
